summary: Short, narrow, tree-covered kerb with a house within 5 m and no room to pull off.

best_section.where: East kerb at the top of this stretch, by the power pole

drivers.seclusion: A house sits 5 m from the kerb at the south end and the brown-roofed house is close along the east side; dense trees hide the rest.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane tight between trees and fences; no clear verge or pull-off wide enough for a van.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on this stretch; a couple park on the street further south.

flags: Slope data noisy: max 35% is a DEM artefact, about 3% over the first 10 m
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the whole stretch, including from the west.
